pick.name: VS Code
pick.what: Editor with the official Claude Code extension
pick.why: Best Claude Code integration and ecosystem; all platforms
pick.install: brew install --cask visual-studio-code | winget install Microsoft.VisualStudioCode | snap/apt

alts.name: Zed
alts.what: Fast editor that can host Claude as an external agent (ACP)
alts.install: brew install --cask zed | winget install ZedIndustries.Zed

alts.name: JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA / PyCharm free)
alts.what: Full IDEs with Claude Code plugin; free unified edition 2025.3+
alts.free_limits: free tier terms differ by IDE; verify

candidates.name: Cursor / Windsurf / Antigravity
candidates.verdict: second AI agent; redundant with Claude Code

decision: With Claude Code doing the editing, the editor is mostly for review; VS Code has the best Claude integration. Pick Zed for speed, JetBrains for deep language tooling.

os_notes.macOS: All editors native; install via Homebrew cask.
os_notes.Windows: VS Code Remote-WSL lets the editor work against a WSL2 checkout.
os_notes.Linux: VS Code ships deb/rpm/snap; Zed available as a native build.

verify.note: Shallow check: no neutrality, pricing or licence defect found; not re-fetched.
